copy.html:
If you dream of winning a life changing jackpot, the California SuperLotto Plus is the lottery for you. It's a fast and fun way to change your life forever. And best of all, it's simple to play!

If there is no winner, the jackpot rolls over each draw! The California SuperLotto Plus draw happens every Wednesday and Saturday at about 19:45 Pacific Time (PT).

How Much Could You Win?

There are nine prize divisions in total, including a minimum jackpot of $7 million.

Do you have the lucky ticket? Be sure to check the latest California SuperLotto Plus results, or look out for an email from LottosOnline to confirm your winnings!

Playing California SuperLotto Plus Online

Do you want to win millions? Playing California SuperLotto Plus online is simple - here's how to do it with LottosOnline!

To buy your ticket California SuperLotto Plus lottery ticket online, simply choose five main numbers from 1 to 47 plus one MEGA number from 1 to 27. If you can't decide, use our Quick Pick random number generator.

Once you have placed your California SuperLotto Plus entry and paid using your prefered payment method, our local ticket purchasing agents - based at our local ticket buying office in California - will purchase the official lottery ticket on your behalf. You don't have to do a thing.

You will receive email confirmation of your lottery ticket purchase. Your official ticket will be held in a secure location until after the draw, when it will be checked and verified for any winnings. If you have won, we will let you know the good news immediately!

You've Won! What Happens Next?

Have you won a prize? Most winnings will reflect in your LottosOnline Winnings Balance as soon as the draw has been verified. If you win the jackpot we will be in touch to dicuss arrangements for you to collect your winning ticket in person. We'll let you know how much you have won via email - so don't worry if you have forgotten to check the latest California SuperLotto Plus results.

Receiving your winning via LottosOnline is simple and straightforward. Just log in to check your Winnings Balance, and decide how to claim it! Either arrange for our agents to transfer it to your bank account, or convert it to credit in your Account Balance to buy more tickets. It really is that simple!

Fun Facts About the California SuperLotto Plus

Did you know?

  • The game started as the California Super Lotto in 1986 and the name was changed to the SuperLotto Plus in 2000.
  • The biggest jackpot to date was a stunning $193,000,000! It was split between three tickets in February 2002.
  • Most of the income from ticket sales is used by the State of California to fund public education programs.
